messages:
Ash: Heads up — saw a weird eviction oscillation on shard-7 tonight. Small tenants (lots of <5 req/s) had repeated cold starts after demote waves. looks like demote -> rehydrate -> demote in ~30s loops.
Maria: Yikes. Can you paste a short log snippet and the metric names?
Ash: Sure — evict_count_per_min spiked to ~240, prefix_rehydrate_latency jumped. Example log: `evict(prefix=tenant-42:keyA) -> prefill(request) -> rehydrate(prefix=tenant-42:keyA)` within 27s.
Kevin: Was this during the prefilling experiment rollback? We changed prefill aggressiveness last week.
Jun: We also cut the soft-demote grace to 30s to free memory earlier. Oscillation is plausible.
Ash: Repro I ran: 5k tenants, 80% small (<5 rps), 1 hot key/tenant. With demote window 30s you see churn. With 90s window churn drops but memory use rises.
Maria: Thinking tradeoffs: stricter demote frees slab space but hurts tail latency for small-tenants that have bursty access. Options: tenant cooldowns, probabilistic step-down, or a short pin after promote.
Kevin: Probabilistic stepping appeals — it's local, low coordination. We tried a naive p=0.2 step in staging and saw ~15% fewer cold starts at ~6% memory overhead.
Jun: Needs bounding: probabilistic keep can bloat memory. We should couple with credit accounting: each prefix has a token budget that decays.
Ash: Proposal sketch: adaptive stepping: if recent_access_rate > R, extend grace; else apply random step with prob p(prefix_score). This gives frequently accessed prefixes bias to stay.
Maria: I'll draft RFC follow-up. Sketch: per-prefix leaky-bucket (accumulate tokens on access, drain on demote). Demote only allowed when tokens < T and rand() < step_prob(tokens). Add metrics to track memory impact.
Kevin: Metrics to add: demote_attempts, demote_blocked_by_tokens, prefix_rehydrate_latency, slab_occupancy_by_tier. Also histograms of rehydrate latency per tenant size.
Ash: Quick pseudocode I used in experiment:
```
function consider_demote(prefix):
  if time_since_last_access < reaccess_threshold:
    return KEEP
  tokens = bucket_level(prefix)
  p = base_step_prob * exp(-alpha * tokens)
  if rand() < p:
    demote(prefix)
  else:
    keep(prefix)
```
Maria: Looks fine. We should also think about fairness: tiny tenants could be starved if their tokens never refill — need min-guarantee.
Jun: Agree. Add a lower bound on retention for small tenants (min_retention_seconds) and dynamic backing off for tenants that hit SLOs.
Ash: Ops question: rollout plan? Start in canary with metric gating (no more than 5% slab increase).
Maria: I'll open a PR with a feature flag and metric checks. Experiment in canary x3, then ramp. Tagging @Kevin @Jun for review.
sre-bot: Canary job created: rollout/prob-demote-canary — monitors: prefix_rehydrate_latency, slab_occupancy; alert if regression > 20% :alert: 
Kevin: :thumbsup:
